articles.summary: Narrows FY26 Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Guidance Ranges with the Midpoints Unchanged, and Reiterates Gross Margin and Free Cash Flow Guidance Traeger, Inc. ("Traeger" or the "Company") (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced its financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter FY26 Results Total revenues decreased 40.4% to $74.7 million Grill revenues decreased 48.1% to $39.7 million Net loss of $28.5 million Adjusted EBITDA loss of $3.3 million Operating cash flow of $9.8 million and free cash flow of $8.4 million Jeremy Andrus, CEO of Traeger, commented, "Our third-quarter revenue came in at the low end of the pacing we outlined last quarter, with some activity shifting into the fourth quarter. We believe consumer demand remains healthier than our reported revenue suggests, particularly at more accessible price points. articles.title: Traeger Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
